The transactions originated from a new device (Windows Desktop MatchOS) and an anonymous proxy IP in Argentina [EV-8cb9add3, EV-c756485a]. Velocity analysis shows three online transactions within 48 hours, above the card's $101.37 average [EV-68e9b258, EV-beee32dc]. The device fingerprint appears in a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-839228f3], and the customer has a prior fraud case CC-4323 [EV-06ff48ed].
